class.name: MVTireSettings
class.brief_description: Tire geometry and brush-model parameters for a wheel.
class.description: Shared tire data referenced by any number of wheels. Units are SI except [member tire_width], which is in millimetres like the original GDScript. The surface multipliers scale the values of the [MVSurface] the wheel is on, so one surface library can serve tires with different compounds. Every setter clamps the value to its valid range and emits [signal Resource.changed] only when the value actually changed.

members.member: Provides additional longitudinal grip when braking.
Length of the tire contact patch in the brush tire model, in metres.
Tire width in millimetres. The width does not directly affect tire friction, but reduces the effects of tire load sensitivity.
Wheel mass in kilograms, used for the moment of inertia of the wheel.
Tire force applied to the ground is also applied to the vehicle body as a torque centred on the wheel. Gives more weight transfer when the centre of gravity is very low.
